purpose: Sparse current map of solver-research questions and the evidence relationships that prevent rediscovery. This is not a second queue; execution priority remains in docs/solver-optimization-workstreams.md.

questions.question: Does the corrected class-1/2/3 residual contain already-demonstrated capability that can be collected without reopening a measured contention mechanism?
questions.result: No direct batch. Class 1 has no reserve headroom; class 3 has exact dispatch/reach evidence but the atlas alone does not establish exact-action nonzero/comparable dose; class 2 mostly rejoins priced policies. The must-turn-biased descendant graduated to its own current treatment question.
constrains: Class-1 menu additions need a materially different allocation contract.
Do not treat the class-3 atlas bucket as a comparable-work negative without exact-action work/dose evidence.
questions.reopensOn: Material production-boundary or provenance reinterpretation.

questions.question: Does the correctly integrated default-off 7M late must-turn-biased repair tier improve solve/work economics on its bounded eligible population without material collateral?
questions.result: No. The frozen 60-row cohort (43 gain + 17 collateral) reproduced the identical 17/60 solved set in both arms: treatment's 4 target-stage solves are exactly the ids a later stage already solves (100% downstream displacement), zero of 43 gain rows rescued, aggregate workSpent +6.5%. Closed negative on economics per the preflight's zero-gain stop rule. R02768/R02180 remain valid capability/placement evidence only, not economics evidence.
constrains: Stays default-OFF; do not widen the dose or retry this unconditional-exposure form without a materially different placement/selector premise.
R02768/R02180 answer 'can it solve anything', not 'does it help under fixed work' -- do not conflate the two when citing this result.
questions.reopensOn: A materially different placement/selector that avoids intercepting rows a later stage already reaches, or a changed allocation contract.

questions.question: Can already-demonstrated capability from materially distinct historical/current evidence sources explain a meaningful share of the current class-5 residual?
questions.result: No for class 5 under the bounded evidence: the corrected six-source union nominates 179/652 current residual rows, distributed 14/28/21/116/0 across classes 1-5, with zero reach into the 431 class-5 rows. The earlier prose value of a 65-row union is invalid and must not be reused. The union is coverage/complementarity evidence, not a count of independent causal confirmations.
constrains: Do not make broader composition/portfolio mining the first explanation for class 5 without a materially new capability source.
Do not generalize the class-5 zero-reach result into a claim that capability memory is low-yield for class 4; 116/123 class-4 rows are nominated by the six-source panel.
Historical closed-treatment signatures remain nomination/calibration evidence, not current production capability.
questions.reopensOn: A materially new capability source with exact/protocol-compatible evidence that reaches class 5 and was not represented in the bounded census.

questions.question: Should portal coarse-state merge be globally enabled on portal-bearing levels?
questions.result: No in the tested global form. The frozen 954-level A/B produced 158 referee-valid gains and 12 losses, including a hard R01273 capability regression that persisted at 10x budget. Bounded second-survivor and predecessor-history subkey salvage shapes also failed their cheapest deterministic gate. Promotion/global placement is closed, while the large positive basin remains capability evidence.
constrains: Do not equate global promotion failure with absence of portal coarse-state capability.
Do not retry the unchanged global merge or the failed bounded-subkey/retention-slot salvage shapes.
Any successor must preserve ordinary production winners, especially the R01273 regression control, and account for fixed-work displacement.
questions.reopensOn: A materially different global mechanism removes the demonstrated regression mechanism and earns a new promotion contract; narrower allocation descendants do not reopen this tested form.

questions.question: Does the September 9 portal coarse-state-merge positive basin still reproduce on current class-4 residual rows under current code and production-shaped work semantics?
questions.result: Fresh: 8/8 stratified-sampled class-4 rows solved and referee-valid under current code/production-matched budgets. Successor question is the least-disruptive allocation form: a dead-last additive whole-ladder retry, not another freshness check and not reopening the global merge.
constrains: Do not reopen the globally enabled treatment: its 12 losses and hard R01273 capability regression remain valid controls.
The successor allocation-form test must preserve ordinary production capability structurally through tier ordering and explicit work accounting.

questions.question: Can fresh portal coarse-state capability be exposed only in a true dead-last additive whole-ladder retry without unacceptable collateral or fixed-work displacement?
questions.result: Yes. Canary passed 2026-09-16 (7/8 freshness rows, R01273 byte-identical, zero non-portal participation), then the full earned 113-row allocation population reproduced 86 referee-valid gains / 0 losses with every non-target stage byte-identical between arms and net lower aggregate workSpent. PROMOTED to production default-ON 2026-09-16 (both STRATEGY_PORTAL_COARSE_STATE_MERGE_DEAD_LAST_RETRY and its _TREATMENT selector). Global placement stays closed negative. R03365 remains a genuine dose miss.
constrains: The global merge form stays default-off and closed; this promotion only concerns the dead-last additive shell+treatment together.
R01273 is a hard regression control for the closed global form, not evidence against this promoted form.
Refresh the production residual/capability-memory views before reusing old class-4 counts; this promotion changes the production boundary.

questions.question: Is generic structural-progress diversity/retention sufficient to fix the recurring class-5 extinction phenotype?
questions.result: Mechanic buckets can preserve fresh progress on selected solved siblings, but class-5 bucket canaries solve nothing and R03229 still prefers DEAD over LIVE. Progress diversity and viable future optionality are distinct.
questions.reopensOn: A new diversity axis tied to a recurring exact-live/exact-dead discriminator, not another generic bucket/width/scorer sweep.

questions.question: Can a small runtime-legal scalar summary of residual capacity, topology scarcity, or joint-obligation compatibility separate exact-LIVE from exact-DEAD extinction states?
questions.result: No. Six prespecified summaries overlap LIVE/DEAD across 31 exact-labelled states on 15 levels; joint-obligation rejects are zero throughout.
questions.reopensOn: A materially new mechanism-specific descriptor premise.

questions.question: Does a compact categorical relation over individual/joint event realizability (which specific interface/order resolves a pending obligation) recur across unrelated parents, distinguishing LIVE from DEAD siblings where scalar summaries do not?
questions.result: No. 449-query frozen population (28 B2 states, 93.5% resolved, 0 correctness alarms): E-FLIP-ORDER's only strong effect (36% realizable) reverses direction between independent parents (S00048/R00060 vs R00064); E-CROSS-VIA/E-PASS-VIA (~88% realizable) show no distance-to-goal separation. Partial LIVE-state realizability is real but not reducible to this vocabulary's compact relation.
constrains: Do not widen this event vocabulary (cross-via/pass-via/flip-order/portal-pair) combinatorially to rescue a null; the prespec's own boundary pushes toward a more expressive search mechanism instead.
Partial LIVE-state event-blocking is preserved as capability-memory evidence, not a production descriptor.
questions.reopensOn: A materially different event family or joint-query formulation, or a board-specific (not rank-order) descriptor for the flip-order direction reversal.

questions.question: Does single-commitment constraint relaxation (per Moonshot A's cheapest falsifier) find small, board-independent-recurring causal cores for exact-DEAD states?
questions.result: The fresh-population reopen condition occurred and the size-1 form was cleanly retested on the strongest matched asset: 23 exact-DEAD siblings plus 2 held-out LIVE siblings from one real production beam frontier. Across 215 single-commitment relaxations, 0/215 flipped to feasible and 0 correctness alarms occurred. Size-1 causal cores are therefore closed negative on this tested form; size-2 remains merely technically possible and is not justified by the size-1 result.
constrains: Do not build runtime conflict/nogood machinery from size-1 commitment cores; the fresh matched population found none.
Do not escalate automatically to pairwise size-2 relaxation. Reopen only if a smaller signal or materially different core family specifically justifies that cost.
questions.reopensOn: New evidence specifically nominates a bounded size-2 or materially different causal-core family with enough expected information value to justify the larger exact-query cost.

questions.question: Is repair locality governed by a small set of coupled earlier commitments rather than rollback distance or prefix length?
questions.result: No, not on Card-E's 156-row rescuable/non-rescuable population. Remaining path length dominates rescuability (Cohen's d=-1.81; 30.2% reconstructable when remaining length <=80 vs 1.0% when >80), far exceeding any commitment-specific feature (largest secondary effect: portal-jumps-already-used, d=0.83, which partially but not fully survives controlling for remaining length).
constrains: Do not build a dependency-conditioned neighbourhood, descent-aware observer, CP-LNS, or adaptive destroy severity from this population's descriptive differences.
The weak portal-jump/intersection-usage secondary signal is preserved as capability-memory evidence, not a standalone finding.
questions.reopensOn: A different repair-retreat population (not Card-E's) or a length-matched/stratified design with more statistical power finds a commitment effect independent of remaining length.

questions.question: Does a compact, cheaply-observable within-run stasis signal predict near-zero marginal continuation value from additional workSpent, beyond generic difficulty/depth/work controls?
questions.result: No, not for the two tested signal forms. On a 28-level first-loss-frontier population (14 dev + 14 confirmation, reused from an unrelated exposure study), within-run stasis-fraction and distinct-badness-count both show near-zero, sign-inconsistent correlation with a 10x work escalation's marginal badness gain on dev (r=-0.16/-0.04) and on the untouched confirmation half (r=+0.02/+0.06) -- despite real marginal value existing (78.6% of levels gained, mean +4.96 badness).
constrains: Do not build restart, early-termination, bandit, or dynamic-scheduling allocation from either tested stasis signal on this population.
The badness-based marginal-improvement finding itself (most levels gain from more work) is preserved as capability-memory context, not an allocation premise.
questions.reopensOn: A different structural-response dimension from H2's own candidate list (mechanic-progress/obligation-order signature, canonical state-family/branch-decision signature) or a different repair-stage population is tested.

questions.question: Does a compact syntactic-state signature collapse without mixing known LIVE/DEAD (or a proxy outcome) behavior, across held-out parents (Moonshot G / behavioral-state quotient)?
questions.result: Two different answers on two populations. On B2 (28 exact-CP-SAT-labelled states, 14 parents), a naive pending-obligation-count signature mixes LIVE and DEAD on the SAME board in 3/9 multi-member groups -- a direct falsification, no held-out split needed. On Card-E (156 states, proxy rescuability label, one state per parent), the same style of signature (excluding remaining length) shows only 1/26 multi-member groups mixed, far purer than a random-shuffle null (p=0.0008) or a length-quintile-blocked null (p=0.0056) -- real cross-parent information beyond chance and beyond the known length confound.
constrains: Do not build canonicalization, retention, or heuristic use from either result alone: B2's falsification does not rule out other signature forms, and Card-E's partial purity is a proxy-label correlate, not exact behavioral equivalence.
The Card-E cross-parent purity is preserved as capability-memory evidence only.
questions.reopensOn: A different signature form (canonical state-family, branch-decision signature) is tested, or a larger exact-labelled population allows a genuine held-out-parent confirmation split for the same-board falsification.

questions.question: Can a recurring solve-local failure shape be reduced to a small sound dead cause with enough repeated-work value for bounded reason reuse?
questions.result: Historical solve-local structural recurrence is real, and current R03046 still shows strong cross-state reached/boundary recurrence. But the historical decision cluster does not survive broadly enough on the current Class-5 residual: only 1/12 deterministic sampled rows reached the preregistered >=25-record informativeness floor. Current-population cause extraction/reuse is therefore closed before implementation.
constrains: Do not build a faster compact-cause extractor, memo, nogood, or reason-reuse treatment for the current Class-5 residual.
Preserve R03046 and R00046 as mechanism evidence only; they do not establish population economics.
No CDCL/LCG/global unsound keys without a new independently earned population.
questions.reopensOn: A materially changed residual or independently nominated failure population restores the historical connectivity-rejection cluster at useful prevalence.

questions.question: Do current exact-labelled extinction pools contain a recurring categorical/interface-state distinction that preserves LIVE material even though scalar future-feasibility summaries fail?
questions.result: The August full-pool projection was executed over 207 ranked pools. The prespecified low-cardinality fixed-width quota keys did not retain the available exact-LIVE alternatives and showed no recurring advantage over generic reserve/width controls. The September archaeology claim that this experiment was unfinished was incorrect and has been superseded.
constrains: Do not rerun the same low-cardinality fixed-width quota projection or fit more fields to the same four historical parents.
A fresh categorical survivor test requires a materially new independently motivated descriptor or survivor mechanism.
questions.reopensOn: New independent exact-labelled evidence earns a materially different categorical key or survivor mechanism.

questions.question: Does the rigorous fixed-endpoint homotopy/winding formulation distinguish exact-LIVE from exact-DEAD frontier material?
questions.result: The original natural B2 population was coverage-null: 28 prefixes across 14 levels contained no same-level/same-start/same-endpoint LIVE/DEAD groups, so the prespecified fixed-endpoint winding comparison could not run. That population limitation was later overtaken by the controlled same-endpoint topology-fork program, which established exact LIVE/DEAD topological contrast through the successor open-path formulation. Do not rerun the old census merely because controlled contrast now exists; its semantic purpose has been superseded by WS2-OPEN-PATH-TOPOLOGY-SIGNATURE and the F3 microscope.
constrains: Do not weaken the fixed-endpoint contract by drawing ad hoc closures merely to manufacture contrast.
Complete-solution class diversity does not itself license an in-loop topology feature or retention quota.

questions.question: Can a mathematically defensible open-path topological signature/reference encode already-incurred commitment and distinguish exact-LIVE from exact-DEAD material without arbitrary endpoint-closure signal?
questions.result: Yes, on a controlled construction. A frozen same-board/same-endpoint human-parent topological-fork pilot found 4 exact-resolved LIVE/DEAD-discordant pairs across 2 independent human parents (P00124, P00137), all matched on every non-history mechanic field the runtime already tracks, all control checks valid, each discordant pair phase-distinct by exactly one full turn (opposite sides of a single board puncture). This earns a microscope step, not production routing of the raw phase coordinate.
constrains: Require an invariance argument and endpoint-identity controls before treating any H-signature as decision-bearing.

First use existing exact-labelled material; if natural contrast remains starved after the representation is defined, use the smallest controlled human-parent topology intervention and exact-label the relevant states.
Generated solvable witnesses do not substitute for exact DEAD labels, and a complete-solution topology axis does not itself justify an in-loop feature.

questions.question: Which generic current-input topology successor is useful after the earned open-path contrast: a compact reusable puncture-side descriptor, a richer per-instance topology derivation, or neither?
questions.result: The microscope ran and produced a qualified answer. A cheap closest-approach side descriptor is 8/8 on untied rows, but that sound subset has zero decision-relevant discordance. All 9 discordant decisive-puncture rows in the expanded 14-pair/7-parent population are tied; tied-case agreement is 7/9 and a local tie-aware refinement does not improve it. The full topology observer remains informative research state, but no compact sound decision-bearing consumer is earned.
constrains: Do not route production directly on raw phase or the tied-case cheap descriptor.
The untied cheap descriptor is a sound fast path only on the tested non-decision-bearing subset; it is not evidence of useful coverage.

Any successor needs either a reliable compact descriptor with non-zero decision-bearing discordance on fresh independent parents or a bounded sound per-instance topology consequence with measured cost.
questions.reopensOn: Fresh independent parents produce non-zero decision-bearing discordance for a sound compact descriptor, or a bounded current-input per-instance topology derivation yields a sound actionable consequence without effectively replaying the full path observer.

questions.question: Can structural mechanic relocation causally identify a missing mechanic-composition capability rather than merely make puzzles generically easier?
questions.result: The portal-terminal instrument is confounded; swap/cs rescue is also dominated by generic difficulty loosening. Clean/confounded cases remain useful calibration evidence.
questions.reopensOn: A manipulation that proves the specific edit, rather than generic loosening, caused the effect.

questions.question: Can admissible-order non-default retry work be repriced from 1.0 toward 0.18 without losing unique capability?
questions.result: The repricing question is not answered by the nominal production A/B: the target tier received zero allocated/spent work and ordinary admissible-order search ignored the per-tier soft work cap. A default-off enforcement seam now exists for a valid future experiment, but plumbing availability does not make the science active. The question remains deferred until current residual evidence earns it and a cheap canary proves real fraction-differentiated target-stage participation.
constrains: Do not launch another 1.0-vs-0.18 confirmation merely because the enforcement seam exists.
A valid canary must enable the enforcement path and show real nonzero target-stage participation plus fraction-differentiated work under a production-shaped node cap before population compute.
questions.reopensOn: Current residual evidence again isolates ordered-systemic loss, and a cheap enforcement-path canary proves nonzero fraction-differentiated target-stage work under a production-shaped node cap.

questions.question: When append-only repair cannot rescue a near miss, is the missing neighborhood better defined by a compact set of earlier coupled commitments than by rollback/path distance?
questions.result: Historical repair-retreat evidence made rollback locality regime-dependent, and an archived descent-aware shadow probe intended to identify the earlier coupled commitment was never executed. This preserves an observer question, not a new repair operator.
constrains: Reopen only after current evidence implicates an interior/early commitment that continuation cannot revise.
Trace changed turn/crossing/axis/portal/visit/obligation commitments before designing CP-LNS, adaptive destroy, or another repair neighborhood.
questions.reopensOn: WS6 sees current exact-labelled or repair-retreat evidence that rescue requires revising an interior/early commitment outside the append-only neighborhood.

questions.question: Does one canonical provenance discovery-event identity appearing on multiple accepted paths reveal current determinism or provenance-schema defects?
questions.result: No current determinism defect earned replay. Most collisions are legitimate replay/multi-output semantics; the 160 isolated-technique tail is historical technique-census source-cell under-resolution already repaired in current provenance.
constrains: Repeated paths sharing one event identity are dependent evidence unless producer semantics establish independence.
questions.reopensOn: A current one-output producer yields a same-event/multiple-path collision after exact source/config context is present.

questions.question: Does D1 future-intersection commitment realizability disagree with actual production beam rank/cutoff decisions often enough, across independent parents, to justify an economics test at the existing ranking consumer?
questions.result: Premise positive, consumer known, economics unresolved. Exact realizability cleanly separates the retained matched states, but the multi-pick evidence is one-parent and lacks production eligibility frequency, actual rank/cutoff disagreement, descendant workSpent and measured information cost. PR #1863 added the shared bounded decision-observation seam needed to collect these quantities without changing ranking.
constrains: No exact-query production mechanism or ranking change before multi-parent production-inert opportunity and economics evidence.
Count decision opportunities and independent parents separately from raw observation rows.

questions.question: Can the separator/decomposition positive be upgraded into a compact dynamic interface contract that preserves the future-relevant history needed for safe composition?
questions.result: Retained A/D3/F3 evidence now nominates a nested C0-C4 contract falsifier: static interface -> boundary kinematics -> exact global accounting -> mutable mechanic history -> bounded path-history/topology. Existing evidence already falsifies raw cut identity, matched endpoints/obligations, length equality alone, local mechanic-contact flags, and the cheap tied-case topology descriptor as sufficient.
constrains: Do not implement decomposition from separator prevalence alone; first run the frozen-prefix nested signature-collision falsifier.
Treat near-unique/full-prefix signatures or unsound tied-case topology shortcuts as contract explosion, not success.
questions.reopensOn: A frozen, independently selected balanced-interface legal-prefix population with exact completion labels can test C0-C4 signature purity, independent-parent support, abstention, and compression.

questions.question: Are production-search-derived relaxed candidates close enough to the accepted-solution manifold, and locally repairable often enough, to justify a complete-path LNS implementation?
questions.result: Stage 1 is positive: accepted solutions cluster. Stage 2 was method-limited because three naive complete-path constructors failed. The later production-search multi-pick work established that real beam frontiers can yield rare exact-LIVE states and that one-pick sampling was the deeper statistical failure. The old generic 'production-quality constructor missing' blocker is therefore too broad; the remaining gap is converting frozen real-search partials into a fair complete relaxed candidate and measuring local repairability.
constrains: Reuse production-search-derived frontier states rather than inventing another heuristic pseudo-state generator.
Do not build full LNS until the repaired Stage-2 falsifier is positive under a frozen candidate-construction method.
questions.reopensOn: A production-search-derived frontier/partial-state construction can be completed or relaxed into a fair full candidate without answer leakage, after which distance-to-solution and local repairability can be measured.

questions.question: Does remaining path length provide transferable current-input allocation value under a shared fixed work budget beyond the Card-E completion-search population?
questions.result: Strong one-population positive: on Card-E completion searches, ascending remaining length captures 16/17 achievable rescues at 20% of full-cap-for-all budget. This establishes practical allocation value for that population/search model, not general scheduler value.
constrains: Do not promote remaining length into a production selector from Card-E alone.
The next test should be one independent shared-budget completion/repair population, preferably with a bounded work ladder, before opening a WS1 policy gate.
questions.reopensOn: An independent shared-budget population exposes the same legal current-input signal and a prespecified length-first order materially improves fixed-work outcome versus an unprioritized control.

questions.question: Did the Class-3 residual receive enough exact-action work from its historically implicated techniques to support any negative capability inference?
questions.result: No current conclusion is possible: 23 Class-3 rows lack committed per-technique work-tranche telemetry. The bounded work-ladder reducer now exists, but analysis tooling cannot reconstruct dose that the producer never recorded.
constrains: Do not treat Class-3 as exposed-and-failed or rerun broad capability work from atlas membership alone.
A future producer must record exact-action participation/work dose prospectively; the work-ladder reducer can analyze it once it exists.
questions.reopensOn: A prospective run records per-technique exact-action participation/work tranche on the Class-3 question population under a comparable protocol.
